highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: It also restores Vulkan Silk.NET packages, strengthens object lifetime safety, and improves allocation behavior in frequently used APIs.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone m152 and incorporates its subsequent upstream stability and servicing changes.
Adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so applications can target Skia's newer GPU architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface can request pixels asynchronously through a backend-neutral API.
Package READMEs now provide clearer usage information directly where consumers install SkiaSharp packages.

bullets.lead: Pixel and region views retain their sources
bullets.detail: SKPixmap-derived views and SKRegion span iteration now keep their backing objects alive while native code uses them.

bullets.lead: Failed raster image creation releases pixel memory
bullets.detail: The raster-image failure path no longer leaves its CoTaskMem pixel buffer allocated.
Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms disposes the previous uniform buffer before replacing it.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz blob conversion releases stream assets
bullets.detail: Converting non-memory-backed streams to HarfBuzz blobs no longer retains the temporary SKStreamAsset.
SKData.SaveTo, encoded-text handling, tag formatting, and runtime-effect uniform lookup avoid unnecessary copies, boxing, strings, and collection growth.

bullets.lead: Handle lookup startup work is reduced
bullets.detail: HandleDictionary caches its reflection-based skip-registration check instead of repeating it during initialization.
SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET is again produced and its Vulkan coverage extends to Android and Linux.
Native Nano Server assets now use FreeType to provide font support.
Pack output now includes native symbols for Apple platforms to improve post-deployment diagnostics.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Nano Server font support through FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and multiple lifetime and allocation improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added the m152 servicing update, restored Vulkan Silk.NET package production, and completed native symbol packaging.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzz shaping avoids an unnecessary feature-array copy, and converting non-memory-backed streams to blobs now releases temporary stream assets.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and the Skia m152 engine update.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback and fixes several object lifetime paths.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 completes the m152 servicing update.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: The candidate restores Vulkan Silk.NET package production and improves Apple native debugging symbols.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 is the stable release with Graphite GPU bindings and the Skia m152 engine.
v4.152.0.body: It includes asynchronous pixel readback, lifetime fixes, and lower-allocation paths for common operations.
